bullets.text: a painted line on the ferry deck that nobody was standing behind. everybody stood behind it anyway.
duck landed at wakayama. shikoku behind it now, the wake already closing where the boat had been. ⛩️
still reading timetables for a crossing that already happened. the numbers are calmer after the fact.
heat sitting on the back of the neck like a hand. not unfriendly, not leaving.
the current does the carrying. the arms just make it look like work.
